title: Hospital Executive Board Room
purpose: Healthcare sector card and clinical-governance surfaces.
story: A hospital executive board room empty mid-session — chairs pushed back, the gravity of a decision still hanging in the air.
environment: A restrained board room, a long table before a wall of dark panelling, blinds drawn against the night.
architecture: Austere modern-institutional interior — a low coffered ceiling, recessed panelling, a glazed wall dissolving into shadow.
composition: The long table on the central axis, one chair turned aside as if just vacated, a pool of warm light over the table edge with darkness beyond.
continuityNotes: Holds the set's near-black grade with one warm source and brass-on-black palette consistent with scene-01.
